Frequently Asked Questions

Find sizing, strength, and ordering details in one place. If you still need help, you can shop standard boxes or request a quote for custom requirements.

What cardboard box sizes are available?
We offer a range of standard sizes suitable for shipping, storage, and moving. If you need a specific size, request a quote and share your dimensions and quantity.
What is the difference between cardboard and corrugated boxes?
Corrugated boxes typically include a fluted layer between linerboards, improving strength for shipping and stacking. Cardboard may be used as a general term, but corrugated is the common choice for transit protection.
Can I order boxes in bulk?
Yes. Bulk orders are available for businesses and frequent shippers. For larger quantities, request a quote so we can match the best option for your box type and requirements.
Do you offer custom box sizes?
Yes. If standard sizes do not fit your products, we can help with custom sizing. Share the internal dimensions and intended use case when requesting a quote.
Which box strength should I choose for shipping?
It depends on product weight, fragility, and transit distance. For heavier or fragile items, stronger corrugated options help reduce crush risk. If unsure, request a quote and share what you’re packing.
Do you provide custom printing on boxes?
Custom printing is available for branded packaging. Request a quote and include your logo/artwork details, print areas, and quantity so we can guide you on the best print approach.
Are your cardboard boxes recyclable?
Most cardboard and corrugated boxes are recyclable. Keeping boxes clean and dry improves recycling acceptance. If you need guidance for a specific use case, we can help.
How do I measure a box correctly?
Use internal dimensions and measure in the order: length × width × height. Include space for inserts or padding when shipping fragile products.
Can I use these boxes for moving and storage?
Yes. Many customers use corrugated boxes for moving and storage. For stacking or heavier items, stronger box options can help reduce bending and collapse over time.
How do I get help choosing the right boxes?
If you know your product size and weight, start with standard boxes in the shop. For custom requirements or bulk orders, request a quote and share your details.
